Use case: compositing. Image1 original small card is sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light and crop; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion. Only human anatomy becomes smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head/body, green-ringed black eyes, source-matching mouth. Preserve real source hair, brows, conditional facial hair, clothes. Retain bareheaded swept-up/wavy dark brown/grey hair, actual eyebrow hair, real round dark spectacles, prominent dark upper-lip moustache plus source-visible short silver/grey chin goatee. Serious closed mouth, exact primary mild angle/head roll. Dark navy/charcoal open civilian suit, actual pale white small check/pattern shirt collar and RED/BURGUNDY necktie area beside note. Preserve real pointed beard texture separately from compact rounded yellow chin anatomy; no long yellow jaw/neck shaft. A clearly rounded short U-shaped lower yellow head, never a long pointed V-shaped jaw, immediately meets raised/broadened existing neckline, very short broad neck transition and minimal throat exposure. No separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping or cream belly bib. Preserve actual open/closed garment and fastening, coherent front/rear collar overlap/contact shadow. Retain complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary color and attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces opaque, alpha only outside complete card silhouette. No invented insignia/text/accessories. Fine primary details indistinct stay understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED swept-up/wavy DARK BROWN/GREY hair, actual eyebrow HAIR, real ROUND DARK spectacles, prominent DARK upper-lip MOUSTACHE plus source-visible short SILVER/GREY CHIN GOATEE. Serious CLOSED mouth, exact primary mild angle/head roll. DARK NAVY/CHARCOAL OPEN civilian suit, actual PALE WHITE small CHECK/PATTERN shirt collar and RED/BURGUNDY necktie area beside note. Preserve real pointed beard texture separately from compact rounded yellow chin anatomy; no long yellow jaw/neck shaft. No cap, military uniform, hidden accessories or extra beard elsewhere.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.

Hair/brows/round dark glasses, real moustache/silver goatee, closed mouth, actual red-burgundy tie/pale patterned shirt/open dark suit remain. Lower YELLOW face itself forms a pointed V below real goatee at shirt opening. Separate exact-master builtin rounded-chin/raised broad collar repair preserving beard/glasses/hair/source roll/light/red tie. Real beard tip alone is not the defect. No visible alpha holes.
